title: RelayPlane tenant event (webhook body), schema_version 2
description: The JSON body RelayPlane POSTs to a subscription. Incompatible changes bump schema_version; adding an OPTIONAL field does not (consumers must ignore unknown fields, but this schema forbids them so that every addition is written down here).

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. 2 replaced provider and source_assignment by channel.

event_id.description: Stable id of the event: the same on every redelivery. Deduplicate on it.

sequence.description: 1, 2, 3... per (subscription, instance), without gaps; a redelivery keeps its number. Reorder by it; a missing number is a delivery you never received (it may be in the dead-letter queue).

channel.description: The messaging channel the event is about. How it is served (the provider, the node, the epoch) is not part of the contract.

timestamp.description: message.received: when the provider stamped the message (second resolution; ties are normal). Other events: when RelayPlane observed the fact.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the request that caused the event (also sent as the traceparent header).

reply_to_provider_message_id.description: Provider id of the message this one quotes. Present only for quoted replies.

from.description: Sender phone number (digits). Falls back to the LID digits only when the provider reported no phone.

type.description: text, image, audio, video, document, sticker, secretEncrypted (an edit whose new content is not readable), or another WhatsApp message type.

text.description: Text, or the caption of a media message.

chat_id.description: Group JID (<id>@g.us); present for group messages only.

sender_lid.description: Opaque WhatsApp LID of the sender, when the provider addressed them that way.

media.description: The attachment, present when the message has one. The event is delivered only after RelayPlane resolved it: status says whether the bytes are available.

media_id.description: Download the bytes with GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}/content (status READY only).

status.description: READY: stored and downloadable. REJECTED: deliberately not downloaded (see reason). FAILED: the provider could not deliver the bytes.

reason.description: Why a media is not READY.

size.description: Bytes. The real size when READY, otherwise what the sender's client declared.

payload.description: Raw provider receipt of a message, keyed by the provider id.
Lifecycle of a message YOU sent through RelayPlane, keyed by the RelayPlane message id.

provider_message_id.description: The id a quoted reply will carry in reply_to_provider_message_id.

sequence_no.description: The message's own per-instance send order (not the delivery sequence).

payload.description: The sender revoked a message (delete for everyone). Whatever it said no longer stands.

provider_message_id.description: Id of the revoked message, as delivered in message.received.
